Based on my search, I can tell you about **"Still in Love with You"** by **Brooks & Dunn**.

## Song Information

"Still in Love with You" is a country song by the American duo **Brooks & Dunn** (Kix Brooks and Ronnie Dunn). It was written by **Don Cook, Kix Brooks, and Ronnie Dunn**, and appeared on their 1993 album **"Hard Workin' Man"**.

## Lyrics Summary

The song is a heartbreak ballad about someone who is leaving but remains deeply in love. The narrator's taxi cab is waiting, and he's trying to say goodbye, but no matter what he imagines doing to escape his feelings—riding off on a horse, flying away with wings, or spending his whole life dreaming—he knows he'd still wake up still in love with the person he's leaving.

**Key lyrics include:**

> *"My taxicab is waiting / Wish I could hold you one last time / After all we had together / There's gotta be a better way / Of telling you goodbye"*

> *"If I had a horse I'd ride off in the sunset / If I had wings I'd fly off in the sky so blue / If I had the time I'd spend my whole life dreaming / But I'd wake up still in love with you"*

The song also mentions traveling to **Baton Rouge by morning**, hoping to be remembered, and wondering if she'll still remember him on lonely nights.

## Musical Style

The song features the classic Brooks & Dunn sound—traditional country with strong harmonies and emotional storytelling. It showcases Ronnie Dunn's powerful lead vocals, which were a hallmark of the duo's biggest ballads.
